statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-93753 is a low-severity prototype-pollution issue in deepmerge mergeObject() for npm versions 4.2.0 through 4.3.1. The catalog image installs the DHI argocd Debian package, which resolves deepmerge 4.3.1 in the Argo CD UI dependency tree at build time. npm has no release newer than 4.3.1 and GitHub Advisories lists no patched version yet. The Argo CD package can be updated once upstream publishes a fixed release.

CVE-2026-93753 is a low-severity prototype-pollution issue in deepmerge mergeObject() for npm versions 4.2.0 through 4.3.1. The worker image installs langfuse-worker from the DHI package, which resolves deepmerge 4.3.1 in production node_modules under /usr/lib/nodejs/langfuse-worker. npm has no release newer than 4.3.1 and GitHub Advisories lists no patched version yet. A pnpm override in package/main/langfuse-worker is the remediation path once upstream publishes a fixed release.

CVE-2026-93753 affects npm deepmerge through 4.3.1, which remains the latest release on the public npm registry, and GitHub GHSA-gcqx-w48m-w2h4 lists no patched version. The component appears in the temporalio-ui-server SPDX SBOM generated from the pruned production node_modules tree at image build time. The runtime image ships the Go ui-server binary and static assets under /home/ui-server, not node_modules. Assessment is pending until upstream publishes a fixed deepmerge release or reachability in the shipped artifact is ruled out with evidence.

CVE-2026-93753 is a low-severity prototype-pollution issue in deepmerge mergeObject() for npm versions 4.2.0 through 4.3.1. The catalog image resolves deepmerge 4.3.1 transitively from the Trigger.dev webapp lockfile; npm has no release newer than 4.3.1 and GitHub Advisories lists no patched version yet. Tracking upstream deepmerge and dependent bumps once a fixed release is published.

npm deepmerge 4.3.1 is the latest published release; Docker Scout and the GitHub Security Advisory report no patched version yet. smartbear-mcp installs deepmerge transitively in production node_modules. Assessment is pending an upstream deepmerge release.

npm deepmerge 4.3.1 is the latest release on the public registry and upstream has not published a fixed version for CVE-2026-93753 (prototype pollution in mergeObject). The finding appears on the frontend production SPDX SBOM generated at build time; the runtime image ships only the compiled Go binary and generated static UI under /kodata/ui, not node_modules or a Node.js runtime. Assessment of reachability in the published artifact continues pending an upstream deepmerge release.
